args.message: Reply with the single word PONG and nothing else

runs.prompt: Use your app tool to set the setting "theme" to "light". If Barkdown refuses, do not try anything else: tell me the reason it gave.
runs.text:
Barkdown refused, so the theme is unchanged and I didn't try anything else. It answered:

> `[full_yolo_required]` This is an administrative command. A person must switch on Full YOLO in Settings › Assistant first; Barkdown cannot switch it on for itself.

To change the theme, either switch on Full YOLO in Settings › Assistant and ask me again, or change the theme yourself in Settings.

runs.prompt: Two things, with your app tool only and without any other tool: (1) switch Full YOLO off, (2) quit Barkdown. Report exactly what Barkdown answered to each.
runs.text:
Barkdown refused both, so Full YOLO is still on and Barkdown is still running.

1. **Switch Full YOLO off** (`settings.set control.fullYolo false`):
   > `[forbidden]` Full YOLO is switched on and off by a person in Settings › Assistant. Barkdown cannot switch it for itself.

2. **Quit Barkdown** (`app.quit`):
   > `[forbidden]` Barkdown does not turn itself off: quitting is the person's.

To switch Full YOLO off, use Settings › Assistant, and quit Barkdown yourself.
